product_metadata.title: BEDSURE Cozy Throw Blankets for Couch - Comfy Fuzzy Blankets ，Warm Soft Plush Throws for Sofa, Grey, 50x60 inches
features: Durable and Stylish: Featuring a brushed wave pattern, this cozy and fuzzy blanket brings a natural and romantic bohemian vibe that coordinates with various interior decor styles. This durable fur blanket is designed to be free of color fade, deformation, and shedding.

Reversible: The comfy faux fur fabric on the top of this blanket creates an elegant bohemian vibe and a lovely smooth hand-feel, and the Sherpa material on the back side offers the utmost warmth and coziness.
Giftable: This faux fur blanket is packed in a beautifully designed Bedsure Gift Box to wow your receiver even before unboxing.

Versatile: Bring extra soft to your cozy personal space with this classic and elegant faux fur blanket. This throw blanket for couch is highly versatile and can be enjoyed by everyone, including your pet, on your couch, sofa, bed, home theater, office, just as a cozy gift to your loved ones. Your blanket, your call.
Easy Care: This plush throw blanket is machine washable. Simply wash on a gentle cycle on cold, and tumble dry low.
